Hair: multicolor-split-streak, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: offset braid mass. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
